overview: A production-ready WooCommerce mobile storefront for thepridexchange.com — featuring guest browsing, full cart/checkout flow, Stripe and PayPal payments, order history, wishlist, and a modern mobile-first UI with light and dark mode.
features: Login & registration with WooCommerce customer creation
Home screen with featured products, new arrivals, and categories
Product listing with filters — category, price, popularity, latest
Product detail with image gallery, variations, and add to cart
Cart with quantity controls, coupon codes, and totals
Checkout with Stripe and PayPal payment methods
Order creation and history via live WooCommerce API
